top_signals.title: Kyiv Allies See War Going Into 2027 After Envoy Meetings
top_signals.summary: Melinda Haring, nonresident senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, said the war in Ukraine shows no signs of slowing and could drag on for another three to four years. Haring said that Putin is hoping to run out the clock on Ukraine by getting into complicated negotiations and undermining the idea of any Ukrainian sovereignty.   (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Firms Crowd US Loan Market in Push to Cut Costs, Fund Deals
top_signals.summary: Companies are flocking to the US loan market as they seek to reprice large chunks of existing debt, with a pickup in leveraged buyout financing adding to the rush.
